official_price_rule: Use only when scanlite fresh=true and generated_at is recent. day_change_pct is previous-close based, not true rolling24h.

scanlite.deep_usable_rule: Detection arrays stay intact. Deep may continue when BTC is fresh and enough actionable liquid candidates exist; final price seal remains mandatory for entry readiness.
scanlite.max_age_note: Informational only: low-liquidity coins can have old last-trade timestamps.

scan.deep_usable_rule: Detection arrays stay intact. Deep may continue when BTC is fresh and enough actionable liquid candidates exist; final price seal remains mandatory for entry readiness.
scan.max_age_note: Informational only: low-liquidity coins can have old last-trade timestamps.

session_context.note: Session is recorded for Replay only. It does not lower production thresholds.

leader_discovery.note: LeaderAcceleration is an unvalidated research score built only from cheap Bithumb scan history. It does not promote, buy, replace TOP5, or alter the official cohort.

mapping_integrity.rule: Final prices are joined by ticker key only and expected_market must equal returned_market. Never zip candidate and price arrays by index.

price_integrity.rule: Trusted final price requires ticker-key mapping + ticker day-range sanity + recent 1m candle-envelope sanity.

final_price_recheck_top15.rule: selected candidates are rechecked after analysis; execution requires price_integrity_ok=true and final_freshness.fresh=true. Any integrity failure triggers one full-set re-audit.
